title: Sharp singular-set bounds for stationary integral varifolds

result.label: Sharp singular-set bounds for stationary integral varifolds
result.statement: Proves that every stationary integral m -varifold in a Euclidean open set has singular set of Hausdorff dimension at most m-1, a sharp bound in every positive dimension and codimension. On round spheres, the family also proves almost-everywhere regularity: the singular set has zero m -dimensional Hausdorff measure.
